test_case.test_name: VP9 profile/bit-depth hardware decode integrity and physical display
test_case.purpose: Validate the exact approved VP9 profile/bit-depth stream is hardware-decoded on the bound GPU with complete frame/keyframe/superframe integrity and displayed without visual defects, independently from VP8.
required_package: Immutable VP9 WebM/Matroska or IVF input and SHA-256; approved profile, bit depth/chroma, dimensions, color/range, rate/time base, duration/frame count, keyframe and superframe map
Golden decoded `framemd5`, expected timestamps and pinned output pixel format
Exact GPU serial/UUID/BDF, driver/VBIOS and ffmpeg/ffprobe build with positive VP9 profile/bit-depth capability and verbose no-fallback NVDEC path
Bounded scratch/evidence root; approved connector/display/mode/player/capture route and qualified visual operator
Health/event thresholds, abort criteria and non-destructive recovery
test_case.test_command: PARAMETERIZED REVIEW-LAYER PROCEDURE — do not execute until approved. Verify VP9 input/golden hashes, scratch capacity, exact GPU profile/bit-depth capability and healthy baseline while preserving logs. Record `ffprobe -v error -show_streams -show_format -show_frames -select_streams v:0 -of json "$VP9_INPUT"`; require explicit VP9 identity and approved profile/bit-depth/chroma, dimensions, color/range, rates, duration/frame count and keyframe/superframe expectations. Record ffmpeg build and hardware decoder capability. Run `ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel repeat+level+verbose -hwaccel "$APPROVED_HWACCEL" -hwaccel_device "$GPU_SELECTOR" -i "$VP9_INPUT" -map 0:v:0 -an -vf "$APPROVED_HW_DOWNLOAD_AND_PIXEL_FORMAT" -f framemd5 "$VP9_ACTUAL_FRAMEMD5"`; require exact hardware VP9 decode/no fallback and complete golden/timestamp equality. Play the complete stream through the approved physical route, collect time-correlated visual evidence and final health/events. Stop on anomaly; do not retry.
test_case.expected_result: VP9 hashes and all profile/bit-depth/keyframe/superframe metadata match; the exact GPU supports and selects the approved hardware VP9 decoder without fallback; every frame/timestamp/signature equals the VP9 golden manifest and ffmpeg exits 0 without error. Complete physical playback shows no corruption, banding beyond reference, color/range error, missing/frozen frames, tearing, crop/aspect or edge artifact; final health is acceptable and evidence is VP9-only.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires every VP9 capability, metadata, frame-signature, health and qualified visual condition. FAIL on ambiguous/generic libvpx identity, VP8 evidence reuse, unsupported required profile/bit depth, fallback, wrong input/GPU, keyframe/superframe/timestamp/frame/signature mismatch, visual defect, nonzero exit or health breach. BLOCKED at runtime—not Engineering Decision Pending—when approved bindings are absent. End user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Reject generic libvpx encode-to-null and VP8 artifacts as VP9 decode evidence; prove exact codec, device capability and no fallback.
Verify immutable VP9 input/golden and profile/bit-depth/keyframe/superframe contract before workload; uniquely tag artifacts.
Use approved bounded scratch only; preserve logs/events and complete configured duration.
Keep decoded-frame integrity distinct from connector-bound human visual proof.
Stop on media/decoder/GPU/thermal/storage/display/evidence anomaly; never retry, reset, reboot, clear logs or alter firmware automatically.
expected_evidence: VP9-only input/golden hashes and ffprobe codec/profile/bit-depth/chroma/dimension/color/rate/frame/keyframe/superframe metadata
Exact GPU/driver/VBIOS/ffmpeg identities, positive VP9 capability, selected hardware decoder and no-fallback log
Complete exit status, timestamp/frame accounting, actual `framemd5` and exact VP9 golden comparison
Connector/display/mode/player identity and full-clip time-correlated qualified visual record
Source Key/Variant tags, VP8 non-reuse audit, scratch/health/events, no-retry audit and end-user verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop the VP9 decoder/player at first failure, preserve VP9-only media, manifests, logs, captures and events and do not retry. Remove only approved scratch after retention and restore only approved display/session state without reset, reboot or firmware action; escalate if health remains abnormal.
